stories.title: Three-week road closure planned for Ewloe as Active Travel works continue
stories.summary: A three-week closure of St David’s Park Spine Road in Ewloe will begin on Tuesday 5 May, as work on the Active Travel scheme at the St David’s Roundabout junction continues. The closure will run from 5 May to 25 May, covering a 33-metre section of the road between the B5125 St David’s Park Roundabout

stories.title: Bus industry calls on next Welsh Government to speed up services
stories.summary: A third of people in Wales would use public transport more often if buses were faster, polling commissioned by the bus and coach industry shows. The findings, published less than a week before the Senedd election on 7 May, accompany a manifesto from the Confederation of Passenger Transport Cymru calling on the next Welsh Government

stories.title: Crayola children’s craft kits recalled by UK regulator over possible asbestos contamination
stories.summary: Two Crayola children’s craft kits sold by major UK retailers have been recalled after warnings the sand inside may contain asbestos. The Office for Product Safety and Standards issued the recalls on 1 May. The affected products are the Crayola Discovery Craft Box, model 35501, barcode 5061047355015. stories.title: New offence of assaulting a retail worker among Crime and Policing Act measures
stories.summary: A package of new crime laws affecting town centres, retailers, vulnerable adults and online knife sales received Royal Assent this week, with North Wales Police set to operate the new powers across Flintshire. The Crime and Policing Act creates more than 70 new measures across England and Wales. Most will come into force in stages
